cohort: All deliveries in California from 2000 to 2010 (n = 4,605,061)
finding: The proportion of births to women with disabilities increased from 2000 to 2010, and while women with disabilities consistently had higher odds of cesarean delivery, this disparity decreased over time.
mod_finding: Women with disabilities had significantly elevated odds of primary cesarean delivery in each year, but the magnitude of the odds ratio decreased over time.
